text:
eva: Quick sync — putting together the offline/on‑prem roadmap checklist for Q3. Need to lock launch gates and priority buckets. Short answers ok.
kevin: TL;DR we should scope M1 to: minimal installer, tenant isolation, KMS integration, and clear rollback path. Everything else as followups.
aj: From field: customers asking for preserved egress IPs and an operator that supports phased upgrades. Many will accept relay/NAT as interim.
sara: Agree. Engineering constraints: operator bundle size affects airgap install time, and delta patching is nontrivial for older k8s versions.
maria: Security gate: we must have KMS + audit log export in the MVP. Also need default hardening profile documented.
leo: QA: we need an end-to-end smoke harness that runs offline: install -> create tenant -> inference request -> upgrade -> rollback. Can we get a stub infra?
kevin: Action: product to publish shipment checklist by EOD Wed. Tentative buckets: MUST (installer, KMS, tenant isolation, rollback), SHOULD (preserve-egress patterns, operator phased upgrade), MAY (bgp peering templates, advanced telemetry).
eva: Quick clarifying Q: for "preserve-egress" are we prioritizing NAT-relay or BGP peering first? Field tradeoffs?
aj: Relay first — faster to ship, lower netops overhead. BGP is high value for large customers but longer runway.
sara: Tech note: relay requires a reliable long‑lived outbound tunnel; we can build relay manager in the operator. BGP needs CNI hooks and route policies; spike is 2w.
maria: Compliance note: BGP peering adds contractual requirements. We should draft an appendix for legal if we pursue.
kevin: Launch criteria draft (short):
```
- Installer: airgap bundle <= 400MB
- KMS: works with AWS KMS/GCP KMS + HSM passthrough
- Tenant isolation: network & data isolation validated by QA
- Rollback: operator-level rollback that restores model versions and KV cache
- E2E smoke: passing in CI for a sample customer topology
- Docs: runbook + minimal network diagram
```
leo: Can we add "upgrade dry‑run" to smoke? Even a subset would catch most issues.
sara: Good call — add upgrade dry‑run for major versions. We'll stub it in the harness.
eva: Risk list (short): bundle bloat, installer flakiness on old distros, missing KMS edgecases, telemetry opt-in confusion.
aj: From sales: customers will accept early GA if we offer fine‑grained upgrade SLAs and a migration concierge.
kevin: Decision proposal: ship GA with relay + operator phased upgrades, mark BGP peering as GA+ feature (target next quarter). If legal/customer asks, we can accelerate BGP as paid integration.
maria: +1 on that plan, with legal appendix if we go to BGP.
leo: QA ok with that sequencing; need tickets for smoke harness + upgrade dry‑run test.
sara: I'll spin up engineering tasks: operator relay manager proto, installer slimline, delta upgrade orchestration.
deploy-bot: New ticket created: https://tracker.internal/RED-4132 "offline/install: smoke harness + upgrade dry-run" assigned to leo (due 2024-07-15) :robot_face: 
kevin: Meeting outcome: product to finalize checklist, engineering to commit to spikes (bundle/relay/BGP), field to align customer expectations. We'll reconvene Fri for go/no-go review.
eva: Thanks all — I'll draft the checklist and ship it in the doc channel. If anyone has blockers before Fri ping me directly. :thumbsup:
